Figure 10: Verifiable state proofs as an advanced profile for cumulative governance. An agent carries the latest signed state voucher; each enforcer verifies the current voucher, updates the state, signs a new proof, and later enforcers verify signature continuity, ordering, and freshness to resist replay.
